scientific_integrity: The infinite statement is proved directly from the exact open-neighborhood sums and parity. The all-function classification, enumerators, minimum layer, and comparison with K_{n,n} are consequences of that criterion. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to crown graphs. The finite verifier checks only 3 <= n <= 8 and is not the proof. Literature searches did not establish global uniqueness; alternate terminology or unindexed older work remains a residual originality risk. The day precision of the earliest source date follows an institutional repository metadata record, while the journal issue itself identifies the year 2001.
title: Signed-total-domination weight enumerator of crown graphs
